# Code Anchors: Drain Invocation

- `components/skills/nxs-distill-unattended/SKILL.md` — the unattended contract, read only when the flag is passed: every question point becomes a stop for the whole run, the taxonomy precheck before any branch is cut, the unwind of this run's own commits, the skipped checkpoint, and the stop report.
